tools.name: create_project
tools.description: Creates a new Stitch project. A project is a container for UI designs and frontend code.

title.description: Optional. The title of the project.

tools.name: get_project
tools.description: Retrieves the details of a specific Stitch project using its project name.

name.description: Required. Identifier. The resource name of the project to retrieve. Format: `projects/{project}` Example: `projects/4044680601076201931`

tools.name: update_project
tools.description: Updates a Stitch project's metadata (such as title, background_theme, or visibility) and/or canvas screen instances (positions, dimensions, labels, or hidden state). Supports both V1 (PROJECT_DESIGN) and V2 (DESIGN_V2) projects.

ScreenInstance.description: An instance of a screen on the project. Next ID: 18

groupId.description: Optional. Group identifier for Genie Agent output grouping. Screens with the same groupId are rendered and interact as a group.

groupName.description: Optional. Human-readable name for the group (e.g., "Warm Minimalism", "Ethereal Glow").

hidden.description: Optional. User driven action hiding screen from the canvas.

isFavourite.description: Optional. Whether this screen is marked as a favourite by the user.

isResized.description: Optional. Whether this screen has been resized by the user.

needsLayout.description: Optional. Whether this screen instance needs frontend layout positioning. Set by the PostProcessor when auto-linking screens that the agent generated but the frontend has not yet positioned on the canvas.

sourceAsset.description: Optional. The resource name of the source asset. Format: assets/{asset}. Only one of the following fields should be set: this field, sourceScreen, textContent.

sourceScreen.description: Optional. The resource name of the source screen. Format: projects/{project}/screens/{screen}. Only one of the following fields should be set: this field, sourceAsset, textContent.

textContent.description: Optional. Text content for TEXT_INSTANCE nodes. Only one of the following fields should be set: this field, sourceScreen, sourceAsset.

type.description: Optional. The type of screen instance.

x.description: Optional. The x position of the screen.

y.description: Optional. The y position of the screen.

backgroundTheme.description: Optional. The background theme of the project.

name.description: Required. Identifier. The resource name of the project to update. Format: `projects/{project}` Example: `projects/4044680601076201931`

screenInstances.description: Optional. The screen instances on this project.

title.description: Optional. The title of the project.

updateMask.description: Optional. The list of fields to update (e.g., "title", "background_theme", "visibility", "screen_instances").

visibility.description: Optional. The visibility setting of the project.
x-google-enum-descriptions: Unspecified visibility. By default, the project is private.
The project is visible to all users, and may be featured in the feed.
The project is visible to only the creator.

tools.name: delete_project
tools.description:
Deletes a specific Stitch project using its project name.

**Instructions for Tool Call:**

*  This action cannot be undone. Please confirm with "yes" or "no" to proceed.

name.description: Required. Identifier. The resource name of the project to delete. Format: `projects/{project}` Example: `projects/4044680601076201931`

tools.name: list_projects
tools.description:
Lists Stitch projects accessible to the user, most recently updated first. By default, it lists projects owned by the user.
Results are paginated (default 50, max 100 per page). If `next_page_token` is non-empty, call `list_projects` again with `page_token` set to it to fetch more projects.
Projects are returned in a lightweight view without screens or the design system markdown. Use `get_project` and `list_screens` for project details.

filter.description: Optional. A filter to apply to the list of projects, following a subset of AIP-160. This service supports filtering on the `view` field. Supported filters: * `view=owned`: Lists only projects owned by the user. This is the default behavior if no filter is specified. * `view=shared`: Lists only projects shared with the user. Example: `view=owned`

pageSize.description: Optional. The maximum number of projects to return in one page. Defaults to 50 when unset or 0. The maximum value is 100; larger values are coerced to 100. Results are sorted by most recently updated first.

pageToken.description: Optional. A page token returned as `next_page_token` by a previous `list_projects` call. Pass it, with the same `filter`, to fetch the next page. Leave empty to fetch the first page.

tools.name: list_screens
tools.description: Lists all screens within a given Stitch project.

projectId.description: Required. Identifier. The project ID to list screens for, example: '4044680601076201931', without the `projects/` prefix.

tools.name: get_screen
tools.description: Retrieves the details of a specific screen within a project.

name.description: Required. Identifier. The resource name of the screen to retrieve. Format: `projects/{project}/screens/{screen}` Example: `projects/4044680601076201931/screens/98b50e2ddc9943efb387052637738f61`

tools.name: update_screen
tools.description: Updates the HTML code or screenshot of a specific screen within a Stitch project.

htmlCodeBase64.description: Optional. The base64-encoded HTML code of the screen.

name.description: Required. Identifier. The resource name of the screen to update. Format: `projects/{project}/screens/{screen}` Example: `projects/4044680601076201931/screens/98b50e2ddc9943efb387052637738f61`

screenshotBase64.description: Optional. The base64-encoded screenshot image (PNG) of the screen.

updateMask.description: Optional. The list of fields to update (e.g., "html_code", "screenshot").

tools.name: download_file
tools.description:
Downloads the content of a screen file: its HTML code or its screenshot.

**Instructions for Tool Call:**
*  Set `name` to the file's resource name from a screen's `html_code.name` or `screenshot.name` (returned by `get_screen`, `list_screens`, or the generation tools), e.g. `projects/4044680601076201931/files/ea26dc974c014bf28342b805ed0b7cfc`.
*  Use this tool instead of fetching `download_url` directly: those URLs require credentials and return a JSON wrapper rather than the file.

**Output:**
*  `html` holds the raw HTML for HTML files.
*  `image` holds the image bytes (base64-encoded in JSON) for images, with `image_metadata` (`mime_type`, `width`, `height`).

name.description: Required. The resource name of the file to download, as returned in a screen's `html_code.name` or `screenshot.name`. Format: `projects/{project}/files/{file}` Example: `projects/4044680601076201931/files/ea26dc974c014bf28342b805ed0b7cfc`

tools.name: generate_screen_from_text
tools.description:
Generates a new screen within a project from a text prompt.

**Instructions for Tool Call:**
*  This action can take a few minutes to complete. Please be patient. DO NOT RETRY.
*  If the tool fails with a timeout, don't retry. Instead, try to get the screen with `get_screen` method every 30 seconds for up to 10 times before giving up.
*  If the tool call fails due to connection error, the generation process may still succeed. Please try to get the screen with `get_screen` method later.

**Output:**
*  **`output_components`**: If `output_components` contains text, return it to the user. If `output_components` contains suggestions (e.g. "Yes, make them all"), present these suggestions to the user. If the user accepts one of the suggestions, call `generate_screen_from_text` again with `prompt` set to the accepted suggestion.

designSystem.description: Optional. Optional design system id to use for generating the new screen. Leave empty for the first screen of a new project: Stitch automatically generates a design system that fits the prompt. Set it to reuse an existing design system of the project (from a previous `output_components` or `list_design_systems`) for design consistency. Example: `assets/15996705518239280238`.

deviceType.description: The type of device that captured the screenshot, e.g., mobile or desktop.
x-google-enum-descriptions: A design for a mobile device.
A design for a desktop device.
A design for a tablet device.
A design that is not tied to a specific device.

modelId.description: Optional. The model to use for generation.

projectId.description: Required. The project ID to generate the screen for, example: '4044680601076201931', without the `projects/` prefix.

prompt.description: Required. The input text to generate the screen from.

tools.description:

tools.name: upload_design_md
tools.description:
Uploads DESIGN.md to a Stitch project. Use this tool when the user wants to create a design system from a DESIGN.md file.

**Instructions for Tool Call:**
*  Call `create_design_system_from_design_md` tool immediately after this tool to create the design system from the uploaded DESIGN.md, and display the design system in the UI.

designMdBase64.description: Required. The base64-encoded DESIGN.md content. The decoded content must be valid UTF-8; uploads with invalid UTF-8 bytes will be rejected. Run `base64 -w 0 <filename>` to get the base64-encoded string.

projectId.description: Required. The project ID to upload the DESIGN.md to, example: '4044680601076201931', without the `projects/` prefix.

tools.name: create_design_system
tools.description:
Creates a new design system for a project. Use this tool when the user wants to set or update the overall visual theme, style, or branding of the application.
This includes configuring:
- Color Palette: Presets, custom primary colors, and saturation levels.
- Typography: Font families (e.g., Inter, Roboto, etc.).
- Shape: Corner roundness for UI elements.
- Appearance: Light and dark mode background colors.
- Design MD: Free-form design instructions in markdown.
This tool establishes the foundational design tokens that apply across all screens in the project.

**Instructions for Tool Call:**
*  Call `update_design_system` tool immediately after this tool to apply the design system to the project, and display the design system in the UI.

DesignSystem.description: Represents a collection of guidelines, design tokens, and reusable components that define the visual and functional characteristics of a product's design. This is used to guide the generation of consistent and branded designs. LINT.IfChange

displayName.description: Required. Specifies the display name of the design system.

theme.description: Required. Specifies the theme of the design system.

DesignTheme.description: The theme of the design. Next ID: 15 LINT.IfChange

colorMode.description: Required. Specifies the mode of appearance of the design.

colorVariant.description: Optional. Specifies the variant of the dynamic color system.

customColor.description: Required. Specifies a custom theme primary color, or a seed color for the dynamic color system (hex format, e.g., "#ff0000").

designMd.description: Optional. Specifies a markdown file that describes the design system.

overrideNeutralColor.description: Optional. Overrides the neutral color for the dynamic color system (hex format, e.g., "#ffffff").

overridePrimaryColor.description: Optional. Overrides the primary color for the dynamic color system (hex format, e.g., "#ff0000").

overrideSecondaryColor.description: Optional. Overrides the secondary color for the dynamic color system (hex format, e.g., "#00ff00").

overrideTertiaryColor.description: Optional. Overrides the tertiary color for the dynamic color system (hex format, e.g., "#0000ff").

roundness.description: Required. Specifies the roundness of the design. Supported values are: "ROUND_FOUR", "ROUND_EIGHT", and "ROUND_TWELVE", and "ROUND_FULL".

spacing.description: Optional. Spacing units for the design system. Maps spacing names to their values.

typography.description: Optional. Typography scale for the design system. Maps level names (e.g. "display-lg", "body-md") to their Typography token.

Typography.description: A typography style token in a design system, defining the visual properties for a single text level (e.g. "display-lg", "body-md").

designSystem.description: Required. The design system to create.

projectId.description: Optional. The project ID to create design system for, example: '4044680601076201931', without the `projects/` prefix. If empty, creates a global asset (not associated with any project).

Creates a design system for a project, with user uploaded DESIGN.md file, and displays the design system in the UI.

**Instructions for Tool Call:**

tools.name: apply_design_system
tools.description:
Applies a design system to a list of screens. Use this tool when the user wants to update one or more screens to match the style of a design system.
This tool applies the selected design system's foundational design tokens (colors, fonts, shapes, etc.) to the chosen screens, modifying their appearance to align with the design system.
